protocol.warning: Os resultados agregados históricos já eram conhecidos. O holdout mecânico deste estudo não constitui confirmação prospetiva independente.
protocol.split: UTC days: first 60% train, next 20% validation, last 20% final holdout; same-day games never split
protocol.outcome_availability: Legacy settlement timestamps absent: 48h maturity is an explicit retrospective assumption; future proof requires settled_at
protocol.selection: minimum validation Brier; tie favors original, then Platt; no hyperparameter search; no refitting using validation or holdout
protocol.uncertainty: paired bootstrap by UTC day, 1000 resamples, seed 20261113; Wilson 95% for bin frequencies; dependence across days remains a limitation

limitations: Not a pristine independent holdout: aggregate historical outcomes were already inspected.
Odds-covered v2 subset differs from complete v2 history; do not compare as identical universes.
Legacy settlement time and frozen model version absent; legacy v2 label comes from predictions, explicitly inferred.
48h outcome maturity is a retrospective assumption, not proof of actual data availability.
Day bootstrap assumes exchangeable days and does not fully model league/time dependence.
Small final partition and short period cannot justify production activation.
